response.overview: Ren has solved countless difficult problems as a "troubleshooter," secretly resolving love affairs in the entertainment district. In his hands, any request is guaranteed to be a success. His targets always fall for Ren's techniques. However, this seemingly perfect man has a dark past. One day, his beloved younger sister, Haruka, jumped off the roof of a multi-tenant building. Ren doesn't know why, and nightmares about it continue to haunt him.  Every year on the anniversary of his sister's death, he places a bouquet of flowers on the building's roof. One year, on the anniversary of her death, Ren finds a man named Naoto, who looks like a host, collapsed on the roof and calls out to him. Naoto had collapsed from hunger, and upon hearing his story, he learns that he was betrayed by a customer at his bar, got into debt, and was fired from his job. With nowhere to go, Ren decides to take Naoto home....
response.title: Delicious Destiny
